rig_constraint.reason: The phase-independent radial non-contact certificate requires only the exact coaxial source hinge line. It deliberately does not invent pin ownership, axial spin behavior, bearing semantics or a physical fastening model.

intent: Explicitly rebind the source-owned bored-knuckle successor to the existing Object lid-rig constraint boundary without silently adopting new geometry. Prove a phase-independent positive radial pin-to-bore clearance for the complete 0..110 degree articulation while keeping pin axial phase and physical ownership unspecified and refusing to promote the Hard-Surface neutral/same-phase 1 mm clearance into a continuous motion claim.
truth_boundary: This Rigging compatibility overlay proves only a source-identical coaxial radial non-contact lower bound for the exact bored-knuckle successor under the existing lid articulation. It does not adopt successor geometry into a production rig, establish pin ownership or spin, preserve a 1 mm clearance at every motion phase, prove axial-stop/collar contact, retention, loads, bearing behavior, tolerance class, wear, lubrication, full-component collision, Animation timing/interpolation/playback, Technical-Art target-host adoption, Runtime/controller/device behavior, physics/gameplay, visual acceptance, CANON or production readiness.
